label: An actual CONCRETE_6 ground of a being whose esse is its essence is a CAUSE_2 of its esse
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: if y is an actual concrete ground at w of x (y concrete, existing at w and grounding x at w under the selected relation), and x is in act as to being with its represented esse equal to its essence, then y causes the esse of x (CausesIn y x esse, CAUSE_2, mode unspecified, tenseless). It is the converse of the esse-cause bridge cb1cdea9, restricted to targets whose esse is their essence; the unrestricted converse (every actual concrete ground causes its target's esse) is stronger and is not stated. No substantive objection is identified; NonCausalGroundControl shows only that the encoded predicates do not force it, satisfying every other input of the first-source-to-root argument without it.
